Prices.title: Prices and Cost of Living in Paraguay
Prices.subtitle: Collected information from actual supermarkets, rental markets, and basic utilities in Paraguay.
Prices.faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions about Cost of Living
Prices.faq1Question: What is the legal minimum wage in Paraguay?
Prices.faq1Answer: The current legal minimum wage in Paraguay is 2,680,373 PYG per month (approximately 365 USD at the current 2026 exchange rate). However, a qualified professional usually earns between 4,000,000 and 8,000,000 PYG.
Prices.faq2Question: How much money is needed to live alone in Asunción?
Prices.faq2Answer: For a single person wishing to live comfortably in a safe area of Asunción (such as Villa Morra or Las Mercedes), the average monthly cost ranges between 800 and 1,200 USD. This covers rent for a studio apartment, utilities, groceries, and basic leisure activities.
Prices.faq3Answer: Yes, the residential electricity rate in Paraguay (provided by ANDE) is one of the most economical in Latin America due to the massive hydroelectric generation of Itaipú. However, heavy use of air conditioning in summer (from November to March) can raise monthly bills to the 40 to 90 USD range. The average residential rate is approximately 0.059 USD per kWh.

Barrios.title: Asunción Zones and Neighborhoods: Safety and Prices
Barrios.subtitle: Choosing the right area in Asunción is the fundamental step before moving. Below, we present a detailed map with boundaries and security statistics, average rental costs, and pros/cons for each residential reference neighborhood.
Barrios.q1Text: Villa Morra and the Aviadores del Chaco Avenue axis (Manora, Ycua Sati) are the preferred areas due to the immense quantity of services, modern corporate offices, gyms, and luxury shopping centers within walking distance.
Barrios.q2Title: Which is the quietest and safest neighborhood?
Barrios.q2Text: Mburucuyá stands out as a purely residential neighborhood, with cobbled streets shaded by huge tree canopies and a presence of embassies, which guarantees a higher-than-average police patrol and surveillance presence.
Barrios.mapDesc: Safety guide and average rental costs in the key residential areas of Asunción.
Barrios.clickPrompt: Click on a neighborhood on the map to see detailed statistics.
Barrios.safetyAlertTitle: Geography of Safety and Exclusion Zones
Barrios.safetyAlertText: Safety in the capital and border areas varies by micro-zone. For a secure relocation, keep in mind the following recommendations based on 2026 local reports:
Barrios.safetyRedZoneText: The Ricardo Brugada neighborhood (La Chacarita, including Pelopincho and Barrio Chino) concentrates high levels of marginality and violent crime. Avoid it completely. Also, exercise caution in Roberto L. Pettit, Santa Ana, Tacumbú, Republicano (Caracolito area), Mundo Aparte, and around the Mercado de Abasto and the Asunción Bus Terminal due to motochorro (motorcycle thief) muggings.
Barrios.safetyModZoneText: The historic downtown (microcentro) requires caution at night after shops close, especially in the vicinity of Colón and Oliva streets. Similarly, transit carefully in Varadero and around the Cementerio del Este.
Barrios.raudalesTitle: Flash Flood Physical Danger: The Raudales in Asunción
Barrios.raudalesText: The greatest physical danger on rainy days is raudales (torrential water currents). Lacking a complete storm drainage system, rainstorms turn the slopes of Asunción and the Central department into raging rivers that sweep away vehicles. Check the main critical intersections:
Barrios.raudalesAsuncionPoints: General Santos Ave. and San Antonio, Perú Ave. and Artigas, República Argentina Ave. and Caaguazú, Eusebio Ayala Ave. and Boggiani, Fernando de la Mora Ave. and Victoria.
Barrios.raudalesLambarePoints: Augusto Roa Bastos Ave. and Arroyo, Cacique Lambaré Ave. and Río Apa, Luis M. Argaña Ave. and Purificación, Bruno Guggiari Ave. and San Rafael (31 points in total).
Barrios.raudalesLuquePoints: Mariscal López and Curupayty, Benigno González and Railway, Vapor Cué and Capitán Insfrán.
Barrios.raudalesFmPoints: Capitán Rivas between Resedá and Centeno, Ettiene from Río Ypané to M. Estigarribia.
